description: Read one known job, its JSON payload and status using the read token. The active claim receipt and role tokens are never returned by this operation.

job_id.description: The job_id from enqueue_agent_queue_job or claim_agent_queue_job.

queue_id.description: The queue_id from create_agent_queue, or from create_agent_run for a run with delegated steps.

read_token.description: The read_token from create_agent_queue, shown once. It reads the queue and its jobs.

name: read_agent_queue_job
title: Read agent queue job
